object_description: slim compact rectangular structure with a small counterpoint volume
design_condition: The building is placed perpendicular to the existing school at the northwest edge, using the terrain to connect multiple entrances with generous outdoor spaces.

positive.statement: The choice of location, orientation, and size is clear and comprehensible.

position.rationale: A slim orthogonal bar is clearly oriented along one edge with a small counterpoint volume.

positive.statement: The slim structure generates a generous amount of open space.

position.rationale: The compact bar leaves a broad visible open field around its footprint.

positive.statement: Different entrances and exits connect the building with the open space through the topography.

position.rationale: Door locations are not individually resolved; the marker uses the terrain-facing building edge.

positive.statement: The simple open-space design gives the children plenty of scope.

position.rationale: The sparse site arrangement visibly creates a generous outdoor zone beside the compact mass.

positive.statement: The compact structure uses resources economically and requires little earth movement.

position.rationale: Resource economy is a whole-building judgment without a single spatial marker.

positive.statement: The flexible construction principle allows the room to be divided as freely as possible.

position.rationale: Flexibility concerns the construction system rather than a distinguishable sampled element.

positive.statement: The compact mass and low height permit regular illumination.

position.rationale: The bar remains low and compact across all elevations, supporting regular illumination.

positive.statement: The structure allows various spatial constellations and can adapt to changing usage requirements.

position.rationale: Adaptability is a building-wide organizational claim without one visible geometric referent.

negative.statement: The preliminary test shows that not all dimensions specified in the spatial program are adhered to because the grid dimensions were defined too narrowly.

position.rationale: Program dimensional compliance is evaluative and has no reliable geometric point anchor.

negative.statement: The proposed transparency prevents the quiet, rather closed room zones necessary for operation.

position.rationale: The principal long elevations are visible, but transparency is not separately distinguishable in the point sample.
